notes.title: BIGGEST MAJOR UPDATE & NEW MAJOR EXPANSION IS COMING + FULL RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Massive content are coming

Empty your minds and lend me your eyes


GPS, a handheld portable device, satellite view of the entire region with potential paranormal places already marked by your HQ.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/0633202a2f1c29ae69631f7f2ee95b3ab23dd89e.jpg
It can also track when you have been and explored.
The GPS could still malfunction in high-activity areas, as all electronic devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/f6333a94e25c8af332ad0a7197a649e9644866d4.jpg

Lots of new major paranormal locations and places-of-interest are added in the woods.
They are interactive and coming in large and small sizes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/d3f17d648157d7f8b4fe57eb9b9b925651acccc4.jpg
You may come across aftermath of different places, to name a few, tourist camping site, cabins, or the witch, or stone formations with paranormal powers...
These locations also brings their own set of items,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/3d19771c346da2ff6983fb00f63c604c4cf50f4c.jpg
Yes, you can play with the ball in this picture.

For example you may find weapons, money stacks or Portable Electricity Generator at a large camping site, pick it up and place it anywhere you need electricity, including inside the woods.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/9844942ca6591cd436300c7987e567317ff5e046.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/728539c3064e678e650b143beee6bfca5130756c.jpg

The woods will be rich with different interactable places and events, including secrets behind puzzled entrance, as all cursed woods should be.
Explore the woods and see where the rabbit hole takes you.

Water sources are more dangerous as Lakes are now a habitant of crocodiles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/637eb88eda1fe3288e1c0886c1c282416a0b0260.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/09b22cc50e42fde897ca5652aecd04fe1a5546a7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/f6399e22975cebc792d0c459f9047d1b52629b9c.jpg

The Plot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/ef558ec0996cdc3e6c0fdd141284983b3d67b7ed.jpg
Welcome to Cinderfall Woods

Starting a new farm, will show a prologue of where you are, where you're coming from, and what has happened.
Discover what happened to the Cinderfall woods that plunged it into fog and darkness.

New Terrifying Entities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/a688d6e567c49500159bde86e3b741b39732cf62.jpg
Including major ones, the witch, and her bodyguard.
You may encounter any of them anywhere anytime, as they roam their cursed land.
if you do you better run and hide.

Bigger Farm with the option to start there instead.
New farm animal, new crops.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2f764f289246b55602748843b4b1028dae0caf96.jpg

The farm app is finally installed and available in the computer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/973df7b9834e1b25235e4be2cdc28f71628193a5.jpg

New wildlife animals, Deer, Crocodile and boar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2f60b10c2c86a1191fa6908655b476f1784ff8f9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/ce1af7d7a0544f9962d07aa678eef5bab8df1335.jpg

Female Character Addition
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/1f61d2abe738122dfb96eddde9c28dd67624394f.jpg
She'll be joining the haunt.

Mausoleums Expansion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/e7910dcb190d0f5d467b482bb91a18b03e3831a2.jpg

The Mausoleums in the deep woods will be more intense to explore! They are now filled with treasures, puzzles and horror.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/67601b99d0661e694f596f6d9cbc39f78c66a1f3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/20ffaf8e832088f082ce103f87d2327cb1114ba7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/863d4c1c387282cf9da0621dc6c64125e892d5c4.jpg
Successful treasure extraction will reward you with $$$$.

And the Biggest addition,
Aside from all above, we'll be getting a complete new game mode, that might deserve its own game.
Be part of the curse investigation team,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/d35b47f72d7843058a0a4297fd649c7bcb76cee5.jpg

In this new mode, grab your EMFs, Blacklight and any gears along with a Soil Measurement tool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/b34178be6d2ff35ace7bd6842469bc5a001ef005.jpg

Go into a curse site in the woods, identify the curse using your tools, based on evidence, and get out (alive if possible).
don't forget your friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/1637d61e98c1d1adbc7ab0f3046780c84679853e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/636fba5f54db33d042b071ce55c58751331fa446.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/4234af9a0f065360eade6702d4f8dd3a345bf399.jpg

The curse sites are at initial stage before their climax, so they don't involve fog barriers or paranormal entities, maybe.
Things could go wrong while you're investigating.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/923a9e825e508d4e735bcff7d1770cfdadb37f36.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/47c56d0fd7a0857494ede966c64db2b4a4b18cd5.jpg

This mode could take anywhere from 5 min to 30 min to complete.
15 types of curse, and 8 evidence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/56065d219c5dc6c3020cae7d4bf521f18cf41496.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2dbe819cf23371b158f1b04dacf1fdc67b5544b8.jpg

And it's not just that, 
The update also brings more fixes and adjustments to the gameplay.

To conclude, this major update add tons of content, and we are getting out of the Early Access.

The full release is expected after this major update, a few weeks apart.

JOIN US!
DISCORD

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE IS LIVE! - New Equipment & Night Events & Holidays
notes.content:
Howdy ho! 🎄🎁
Empty your minds and gaze upon this text,


NEW EQUIPMENTS
A new shop just opened it's doors bringing paranormal investigators their tools to easily find and track their goals.
They h

There are 5 new devices all unique in their own ways. They can be used to help with tracking and finding certain cursed objects, Including abnormal activities, ghost signs, and anything that is paranormal in any way.

BLACK LIGHT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/196c665c2b198bfce3a4712dd00489532a6a88d0.jpg
Used to reveal ghost signs and ghost's footprints which points toward the direction of a cursed object.
If you happen to track an abnormal activity that has no physical appearances, check the surroundings with the UV light.

RADIO
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/4d76cff7d0973b80a4bde15c03aed530380092cd.jpg
Entry level for paranormal investigators, Listen to frequency that are in your proximity, it displays how far or close your are to the source.

EMF
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/a32e12928277ef3c6d3f482ab6dce8f725f68d36.jpg
Bread and Butter of paranormal investigators, 5-lights indicator that determine how close you are to the source, as well as a beeping sound, the closer you are, the faster it beeps.

EMF METER
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/2d59a262bc95734660d61350b3a0fd3ee6e728e6.jpg
Similar to EMF but without the lights and the beeping, has a range of 120 meters and comes with a range changer, which is very useful in pin pointing the source.

PARABOLIC MICROPHONE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/bee3711c11f1618d3fea285efd7c0d7b6dfe887f.jpg
The all-in-one solution, Built-in display with detection meter and speaker.
Detects and filter out only the activity it's been set to, for instance, curses only.
The detection is limited, it has to be pointed toward a source direction, but could pin-point the source from far away.
It's a little pricey, If you have a thousand bucks laying around in your farm, one can dream.


NIGHT EVENTS
Each night the curse could change things for your farm and the entire woods, some nights could be Heavy with paranormal activities whiles others calm with not activity at all.
You will know about the night at each sunset.


 Blood moon
Heavy attack on the farm
 Bright Moon
Low paranormal activity
 Dark Moon
Near pitch-black everywhere
 Calm Night
No paranormal activity, even the woods can be explored at midnight with no dangers, but the major entities will still roam their territory.
 Normal Nights
As in a Normal night in the haunted woods, but with nothing extra.
 More to come.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917353/26e6a7d836db68d4424366b03ccfc84f9af20f39.jpg
At sunset the major night event is known, here it's the "Blood Moon".

The woods become pitch-black at midnight, more dangerous. For those who lost their way back home, there is still hope as something "friendly" at midnight could find you before others do.

Also in the same update:

 Glowstick and lighter performance has been improved
 Very low paranormal activity in the woods From 6 to 12 in the morning.
 Tax and Tip is no more in the shops
 New achievements "Path Angel" and "Ritual Book"
 Anything paranormal can be tracked using the new devices
 Shovel has been added to the Shop
 Shop Screens can be scrolled using the mouse wheel
 HDR is now supported and can be enabled in the VIDEO SETTINGS on supported displays.


Planned for the next major updates

 Bigger farm and farmhouse variant.
 Investigation Work: Your farm could become haunted from those heavy paranormal night attacks. Investigate your farm to find clues and identify the haunter, Prepare based on it's type and exorcise it before your farm is cursed.
 Large Building Blueprint: Designate an area for construction (e.g., a barn), then bring the necessary resources to build it.
 And more


STEAM DECK
DTW is now playable on the Steam Deck. However the control will definitely needs to be find tuned.

We have a discord here:
Discord Server

notes.title: Halloween Event is Ending And Getting Prepared for Christmas
notes.content:
We are getting closer to Christmas,
Much like the Halloween event, there will be special seeds and items available during the Christmas event, more detail will be announced in December.

With the Halloween event ending on 15th November, Here is what happens to the items from this event:

Trick or Treat Event (Gone with the event)
Trick-or-treaters come knocking at your door every night.
They will have treat expectations that must be fulfilled, other wise bad things will happen 👻.

Pumpkin Seeds 🌱 (Remains Available)
Get into the Halloween spirit by planting pumpkin seeds. Watch them grow into vibrant pumpkins just in time for Halloween!

Create Pumpkin Lanterns 🕯️ (Gone with the event)
Once your pumpkins are ready, harvest them and use the workbench to carve them into spooky lanterns. Decorate your farm, easily change their size as you place them.

Black Cats 🐈‍⬛ (No Longer Appearing In The Woods)
Black Cats are appearing throughout the woods and need rescuing, see how many black cats you can bring into your farm, Selling & Extracting them are also profitable.



We have a discord server,
Discord Server

notes.title: 🎃 HALLOWEEN EVENT & UPDATE + RECENT UPDATE RECAP
notes.content:
HALLOWEEN IS COMING 

The spookiest time of the year is near! and it means only two things: Pumpkin.
It's hauntingly a good times to plant pumpkins.

Plant Pumpkin Seeds 🌱
Get into the Halloween spirit by planting pumpkin seeds. Watch them grow into vibrant pumpkins just in time for Halloween!

Create Pumpkin Lanterns 🕯️
Once your pumpkins are ready, harvest them and use the workbench to carve them into spooky lanterns. Decorate your farm, easily change their size using (z) and (X) as you place them and be ready to get visits from unexpected trick-or-treaters 👻.

Black Cats 🐈‍⬛
Black Cats are appearing throughout the woods and need rescuing, see how many black cats you can bring into your farm, Selling & Extracting them are also profitable.


But there is more

Trick or Treat Event

They will have treat expectations that must be fulfilled, other wise bad things will happen 👻.

Until the Trick or Treat Event, Plant and grow the pumpkins, carve them into Jack O'Lanterns, look for black cats and decorate your farm for the true Halloween.

New and fresh achievements will be added with each feature update.

Spanish, Polish, Korean, Turkish languages support

notes.title: (0.0.2.1) Save Fix
notes.content:

Reported by the community.

[FIXED] Resources in the backpack, seed, wood and fruits alike are gone after loading a save.
[FIXED] Grown crops are gone after loading a save.
[FIXED] Grown crops aren't shown correctly for people who join at a later.

[FIXED] In co-op the host will crash after sometimes when someone joins.
[FIXED] Pets custom name isn't shown after loading a save.
[FIXED] The pet's name isn't displayed on the Animal House after loading a save.
[FIXED] Glowsticks that were lit before aren't lit after loading a save.
[FIXED] Workbench displays the placement arrow after loading a save.
[FIXED] Cursed objects that are found, are shown the found message after picking them up again.

notes.title: Release Date Change + See What's Coming
notes.content:
Greetings descenders,

Let me just start by telling you that I'm aware I have no audacity in asking you to wait longer for release as it was changed twice already (21st, 23rd JUNE), 

This time the release date is locked at July 12th
Now I'm aware that most of you if not all, were anticipating the release, even have planned ahead if you're a content creator, Please bear with me, the game will be in a better shape at the end of this time frame.

There are two reasons for the delayed release,
The first one is that I don't want to give you a game that isn't polished to a degree, 
The second reason is that the time it took for Steam to review the game until now, I came to an understanding that the title needs a little more time to being polished for release, thus the date-change to July 12th.

So here is what's coming
There have been features planned to be added after the early access release given the original launch date wouldn't change, Now that it's delayed, they will be added prior to the upcoming date.
If you have any suggestions or improvements that you want to see in the game, now is a very good time.

SPOILER ALERT
If you don't want to see what's coming and you rather wait for it, this is it, the spoiler alert ends at the line below.
No scary spoilers are shown, those are saved for when you're venturing into the deep haunted woods. 



DEEP WOODS
